plainLanguage: Section 74 inafafanua unlawful assembly na riot. Unlawful assembly inaweza kutokea pale watu watatu au zaidi wanapokusanyika kwa intent iliyotajwa au wanapoendesha common purpose kwa namna inayosababisha reasonable fear ya breach of peace. Riot hutokea unlawful assembly inapoanza kutekeleza purpose yake kwa breach of peace na terror of the public.
meaning: The section is definitional. Subsection (1) defines unlawful assembly, subsection (2) confirms a gathering initially lawful can become unlawful through later conduct, and subsection (3) defines when an unlawful assembly becomes a riot.
keyPoints: Threshold is three or more persons.
The statutory intent/common-purpose and conduct requirements matter.
Reasonable fear of breach of peace is part of subsection (1).
An originally lawful assembly can later become unlawful.
A riot requires an unlawful assembly beginning to execute its purpose by breach of peace and to the terror of the public.

legalTerms.meaning: Definitions are supplied by section 74 itself.

history.summary: Section 074 is recorded in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text verified before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The statutory definition should be applied element by element rather than from the label alone.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The nature of the gathering, common purpose, conduct and statutory threshold must be assessed from evidence and context.

debateQuestion: Je, facts zinatimiza exact statutory requirements zinazohusiana na section 074?
